seoTitle: Hostinger Dark Web Monitoring: Setup & Pricing
metaDescription: See how Hostinger's Dark Web Monitoring protects your website by detecting leaked credentials, plus its pricing and whether it's worth enabling.
intro: Stolen credentials and leaked data circulating on the dark web can put your website and business at risk without you ever knowing, which is where Hostinger's Dark Web Monitoring comes in. This guide explains how the feature detects suspicious activity tied to your domain, what it costs, and how to decide if it's worth turning on.

steps.heading: Understand what Dark Web Monitoring checks for
steps.body: The feature scans for stolen credentials, leaked data, and suspicious activity linked to your domain across the dark web.

steps.heading: Review the pricing
steps.body: Check how Dark Web Monitoring is priced within Hostinger's plans before deciding to enable it.

steps.heading: Enable monitoring from your dashboard
steps.body: Turn the feature on through Hostinger's control panel so it starts watching for threats tied to your domain.

steps.heading: Respond to real-time alerts
steps.body: When you receive an alert about compromised data, act quickly to secure any exposed accounts or credentials.

faq.question: What does Hostinger Dark Web Monitoring actually detect?
faq.answer: It looks for stolen credentials, leaked data, and suspicious activity connected to your domain across dark web sources.

faq.question: Is Dark Web Monitoring worth the price?
faq.answer: That depends on how much you value proactive security; the guide covers pricing and reviews to help you weigh the cost against the protection.

faq.question: Who should consider enabling this feature?
faq.answer: Website owners who care about privacy and want early warning of data leaks or credential theft tied to their domain.

faq.question: Do I get real-time alerts?
faq.answer: Yes, the feature is designed to send real-time alerts so you can secure your digital presence proactively.
